provenance.method: Coordinator reviewed the category-limited historical political associations, original matching non-deprecated P41 qualifiers and precision, Gregorian dates, entity envelopes, graphic-period contradictions, conflicts, source reuse and original Commons licensing/attribution. Straightforward source-family records are accepted only inside conservative dated intervals. Undated, competing, mismatched-period, missing-envelope, oversized and pending SVG cases remain held. Duplicate source-country rows for the same entity/symbol/period are reconciled; no modern identity fallback and no accepted source or historical fact overwritten.
